frames.visible_job: Draws one wide oval rim and joins it to a short tapered wall.
frames.instruction: Draw one wide shallow oval, echo its lower edge to make the thick stone rim, then drop two short sides and join them with one curved lower edge for the wall.
adds: oval stone rim and tapered well wall
introduces: oval stone rim and tapered well wall

frames.visible_job: Adds two rear posts and one crossbeam behind the established rim.
frames.instruction: From behind the left and right rim edges, raise exactly two upright posts and bridge their tops with one thick horizontal beam. Stop every hidden post line at the stone rim.
adds: two rear posts and top crossbeam
introduces: two rear posts and top crossbeam

frames.visible_job: Adds the connected spindle, crank, rope, and bucket inside the opening.
frames.instruction: Run one spindle between the posts, bend one short crank from its right end, drop one rope from the spindle center, and attach the rope to one small bucket hanging inside the oval opening.
adds: crank spindle handle rope and bucket
introduces: crank spindle handle rope and bucket

frames.step_name: Build the stone and wood texture
frames.visible_job: Adds staggered stone joints, rim blocks, and restrained wood grain.
frames.instruction: Divide the wall into broad staggered stones, split the rim into chunky blocks, and pull a few grain lines along both posts and the top beam without crossing the rope or bucket.

frames.visible_job: Adds three grass tufts and one broken ground shadow around the completed structure.
frames.instruction: Place exactly three small grass tufts around the base and one soft broken shadow beneath the wall. Keep the crank, rope, bucket, masonry joints, and timber connections fully readable.
adds: grass tufts and broken ground shadow
introduces: grass tufts and broken ground shadow

final_step.visible_job: Colors and shades only the established stone, timber, grass, bucket, opening, and shadow.
final_step.instruction: Layer warm gray over the established stones, brown along the timber and bucket, muted green through the same three grass tufts, and cool graphite inside the opening and existing shadow. Add no new contours.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop gives the learner one wide shallow rim ellipse, a clearly echoed inner edge, and a short joined wall in the final position. Those connected shapes establish the opening, width, ground height, and usable empty space for the later timber frame.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the full six-cell sheet and all six saved JPGs at readable size, then compared every adjacent pair with its written instruction. The rim, wall, two posts, top beam, spindle, crank, centered rope, attached bucket, masonry, three grass tufts, and shadow keep coherent anchors and overlap order; the finish adds restrained color and value without new structure.
